en: A vintage Russian Empire postal card printed on light brown card stock. At the top center, in red Cyrillic letters, it reads 'ПОЧТОВАЯ КАРТОЧКА' (Postal Card). On the left is a red imperial coat of arms. On the right is a red postage stamp with the Russian imperial double-headed eagle, overstruck with several circular black postmarks that read 'ГАФСАЛЬ'. The card is filled with handwritten addressing text in a mix of Cyrillic and Latin script, including a German-style salutation at the bottom.
